notes: Read-only Tier-1 capture on a healthy running pardal (python PID 1008). CPU/RSS via tools/sample_resource.sh (--match pardal/main.py, 60 samples, label running_baseline). SLO via tools/probe_http.sh: GET /network-test/ and /network-test/internet_test_previous_result (--repeats 40); GET /network-test/get_file?size=1048576 single bounded 1 MiB download (--repeats 10, transfer-dominated latency). SPEED_TEST was initialized at service boot on this host so internet_test_previous_result returned 200 JSON (not 500). NO mutating routes: POST /post_file not exercised. Tier-2/hazard NOT exercised: GET /internet_best_server, /internet_download_speed, /internet_upload_speed (WAN speedtest saturates operator link); WebSocket /ws echo not probed. Raw evidence: /tmp/pardal_sample.json, /tmp/pardal_slo_fast.json, /tmp/pardal_slo_getfile.json.

route_inventory.note: WAN speedtest routes saturate the vehicle internet link; WebSocket /ws requires a live session; POST /post_file needs upload body.

running_baseline.note: GET contracts on a healthy running pardal (idle, no active LAN speed test UI session).

GET /network-test/get_file?size=1048576.body_predicate: 1 MiB random byte stream (Content-Length: 1048576); not JSON

slo_running_baseline.note: Root and previous_result are fast metadata reads. get_file probed separately at n=10 because latency is dominated by 1 MiB transfer over the operator link, not server handler overhead.

GET /network-test/get_file?size=1048576.note: Transfer-dominated; reflects ~1 MiB download throughput over LAN, not aiohttp routing overhead alone.

running_baseline.method: /proc stat deltas, top-style (100 == 1 core), PID 1008 python pardal/main.py
running_baseline.note: Idle with no active speed test; RSS flat ~39 MB, CPU near zero.

navigator.firmware: n/a (pardal is network diagnostics only; no autopilot coupling)
navigator.notes: pardal behavior is platform-independent (local random-byte streaming and optional speedtest-cli WAN probes); runtime captured on Navigator Pi4 only.

state_machine: none (service_definition states: Unknown; SPEED_TEST global and request handlers are ephemeral test state)
settings_mutations: Not exercised. pardal has no settings manager or settings.json persistence.
